page_title: FUL 1-1 ARS | Fulham v Arsenal 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Declan Rice (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' David Raya displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
90+6' A pass from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is intercepted by Bernd Leno and the move breaks down.
90+2' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) replacing Sasa Lukic.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Arsenal due to an offside in the build-up play.
88' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Arsenal players aren’t happy.
88' Goal! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) finds some space in the penalty area after latching onto a cross and finds the back of the net with a sweet header!
86' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Antonee Robinson (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
82' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
80' Today's match ends for Raul Jimenez who will be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
79' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a yellow card.
79' The substitution is prepared. Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Martin Odegaard.
76' Declan Rice (Arsenal) attempts to feed Gabriel Jesus with a chip pass, but Bernd Leno reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
74' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Kai Havertz will be replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
74' Substitution. Mikel Merino (Arsenal) in, Jorginho out.
72' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
72' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but David Raya pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
70' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
69' Declan Rice (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
69' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
66' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) and Martin Odegaard attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
65' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) tries to find Gabriel Martinelli, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
62' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
61' Adama Traore will be replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
61' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) replaces Emile Smith Rowe.
60' Substitution. Leandro Trossard did his best and is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
57' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
55' No offside! Referee Chris Kavanagh points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Arsenal players.
54' Wait! Referee Chris Kavanagh has indicated he is going to review the Arsenal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
52' 1 - 1 Gooal! William Saliba (Arsenal) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Kai Havertz. He makes it 1:1.
52' Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
50' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
50' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.
50' A pass from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Issa Diop (Fulham) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' The ball possession at the moment is 32:68.
40' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find Declan Rice, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
38' A dangerous looking corner kick from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared to safety by the defence.

38' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Bernd Leno makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner.
37' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
33' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
30' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
26' A cross into the box picks out Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
24' Ooh that was close! Declan Rice (Arsenal) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.

24' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
23' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) brings his opponent down. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Arsenal will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
22' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Bernd Leno intercepts it and averts the threat.

21' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.
20' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
18' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
17' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
13' A rebound falls kindly for Declan Rice (Arsenal), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
13' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but Bernd Leno leaps into the air and clears the danger.
13' Arsenal will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.

11' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Raul Jimenez (Fulham). Kenny Tete plays a fantastic through ball and finds Raul Jimenez (Fulham), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
4' What a miss! The corner finds William Saliba (Arsenal) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
3' Arsenal will take a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will officiate today.
